fusions.name: Linked Discharge
fusions.desc: Empties a capacitor into the first enemy it meets, which deals 7 damage, then arcs to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each for 60% of that damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Coupling Harpoon
fusions.desc: Fires a harpoon on a reel at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Capstan Drag
fusions.desc: Stakes a powered capstan whose line runs 6 tiles for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cascade Relay
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, an arc leaps from the body to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
